scientific_integrity: Finite Gaussian cone spectra and the derived exact collision moments are explicitly credited as implications of existing partial-permutohedron work. scientific_limitations: Standard Euclidean coordinate realization, iid isotropic Gaussian objectives, fixed integer r>=2 as n tends to infinity. No uniformity in growing r and no independent audit.
title: Gaussian collision condensation for generalized parking-function polytopes
